title: 市场不买账法国路线图：问题不在路线图，0.5%增长能撑住赤字吗？

segments.en: Do you think when comes to Europe and you know look at friends? Is there a credible pathway to to sort of a fiscal path here?
segments.zh: 你认为欧洲，尤其是法国，有可信的财政路径吗？

segments.en: I will be from can honest with you in over the short run no the problem we have and the the reason why the market are
segments.zh: 坦率地说，短期内没有。我们面临的问题，以及市场

segments.en: Struggling with the French case is because we have no growth. I mean growth in France is so weak that we cannot address this is called deficit issue
segments.zh: 对法国案例感到纠结，是因为没有增长。法国增长太弱，无法解决所谓的赤字问题

segments.en: And the point is when you look at the numbers 0.4% expected by the
segments.zh: 关键是看数字，政府预期0.4%

segments.en: The government 0.5% in our scenario means that you cannot control your deficit or at least at a very elevated cost
segments.zh: 我们情景中是0.5%，这意味着无法控制赤字，或至少成本极高

segments.en: So the point again. The market has not saying that the roadmap is not credible the economic situation is quite complex
segments.zh: 所以，市场并不是说路线图不可信，而是经济形势相当复杂
